candidate: Patch original ConfigFile values only. Unknown sections preserved. Disk roundtrip equality and independent strict SaveData load before atomic activation.
critical: Unknown parentage, IDs, receipts, progression, awards, genetic finishes and emblems remain protected.
scope: Automatic correction of known cosmetic faults found during load. Newly invalid runtime save candidates remain blocked rather than persisted. No recovery of arbitrary corruption.

Independent candidate validation failure leaves original untouched
Second recovery never overwrites first backup
Unknown sections and genetic finish preserved
Changed source between read and backup rejected
limitations: No simulated power loss or full-disk fault.
